_: Tue 6 Oct 2026 · market slot. Realtor.com county counts read off FRED on 2 Oct 2026 (series ACTLISCOU13151 and PRIREDCOU13151, updated 1 Oct). Active listings: Sep 2026 1,348 · Aug 2026 1,340 · Sep 2025 1,341 (from the FRED data file). Price-reduced count: Sep 2026 490 · Aug 2026 532. No Sep 2025 price-reduced figure was available, so the card compares price cuts with August only and never claims a year-on-year change for them. Deliberately NOT the Freddie Mac rate card: market-one-figure needs APPROVED=1 at publish and the scheduled run cannot supply it.
headline:
About The Same Number
Of Homes For Sale
titan_line: Echo, Realtor.com counted 1,348 homes for sale in Henry County in September. Last September it was 1,341. And 490 had a price cut, down from 532 in August.
checks_rows: Counts single-family homes, condos and townhomes
Active listings are homes on the market that month
echo_line: A price cut? …Oh. The seller lowered the asking number. So fewer sellers did that than in August.
source: Realtor.com via FRED · Henry County, GA active & price-reduced listings · retrieved Oct 2, 2026
disclaimer: County-wide counts for the month stated. Not a valuation or a prediction for any individual home.
